cohort: Reproductive-aged women (18-42 years) who received two Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccines and did not have ovarian failure, were not undergoing fertility treatments, pregnant, or previously infected/vaccinated.
finding: Ovarian reserve, as assessed by serum AMH levels, was not significantly altered at 3 months following mRNA SARS-CoV-2 vaccination in reproductive-aged women.
